contentBlocks.text: Muay Thai at The Vault brings authentic striking technique into a private, premium training environment — pads, clinch work, conditioning, and fight fitness.
Train 1:1 with specialist coaches who can build your skills from the foundations up, or sharpen the tools you already have for competition or fitness.
Our dedicated combat space means you can focus on technique and power without the distractions of a busy commercial gym floor.

seo.title: Muay Thai | The Vault Private Gym
seo.description: Train Muay Thai at The Vault Gym in Shoreditch — technique, pad work, and conditioning with specialist coaching in a dedicated combat space.
